name: Azuma Foods International Inc USA
old_description: Azuma Foods International Inc. USA (AFI) strives to convey an "Assimilation of Food Culture to the World" by combining traditional Japanese cuisine with the world's many food traditions.
about:
Azuma Foods International Inc. USA (AFI) was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The business was created to bring traditional Japanese food culture to a global audience by merging it with other culinary traditions.

AFI specializes in the import, processing, and distribution of Japanese-inspired seafood and specialty food products. Its product lines include tobikko (flying fish roe), masago (capelin roe), dry toppings, seaweed salad, calamari salad, and a range of sushi-grade, appetizer, fry-and-grill, and plant-based items. The company operates an in-house laboratory equipped for pathogen testing using PCR thermal cyclers, ELISA assays, and culture methods, and it develops new products through its R&D team. All foreign suppliers must provide HACCP plans and certificates of compliance, and AFI manages allergen control, gluten testing, and FSVP programs.

The company primarily serves the food service industry, supplying restaurants, catering operations, and institutional kitchens with ready-to-use seafood salads, roe products, and plant-based options. Its menu catalog and recipe ideas target chefs and food service buyers looking for Japanese-inspired ingredients.

AFI was founded on the principle of assimilating food cultures, aiming to introduce traditional Japanese flavors to global markets through innovative product development. The company emphasizes rigorous food safety, with HACCP and SQF certifications, third-party audits, and a comprehensive quality management system that covers everything from supplier verification to in-house microbial testing.
